hook: How is Pablo Escobar connected to Winnie the Pooh?
title: How is Pablo Escobar connected to Winnie the Pooh?
description: A TV star, two presidents, Frank Sinatra and Hollywood's honorary mayor connect Pablo Escobar to Winnie the Pooh in six real photos.

Winnie the Pooh (Disney character).label: Winnie the Pooh
Winnie the Pooh (Disney character).hook_photo: File:Winnie the pooh in a restaurant.jpg

links.line: In 1983, Colombia's biggest TV star, Virginia Vallejo, interviewed Pablo Escobar, and became his lover.
In 1984, Vallejo was photographed with Colombia's president, Belisario Betancur.
In 1985, Betancur visited Ronald Reagan at the White House.

image.file: File:President Ronald Reagan and Nancy Reagan with Frank Sinatra (cropped).jpg

links.line: Reagan's old Hollywood friend Frank Sinatra was a regular at his White House.

image.file: File:Mrs. Reagan Singing with Frank Sinatra Johnny Grant and Nika Costa at The "To Love a Child" Luncheon on The White House South Lawn - DPLA - e6d78a4758d3df2626f087c0ed01da42.jpg

links.line: In 1982, Sinatra sang on the White House lawn with Johnny Grant, Hollywood's honorary mayor.
And in 2006, Grant handed Winnie the Pooh his own star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame.
